summary:
Implementation plan to optimize system backup speed and drastically reduce backup file size through:
1. Gzip compression (.json.gz) reducing size by 75-90%
2. Asynchronous background cloud upload to prevent UI freezes and network timeouts
3. Exclusion/option to bypass verbose audit logs (system_logs, database_logs)
4. Fast single-store backup targeting the active business rather than iterating over all stores
5. Backward-compatible decompression on restore/verify endpoints
